arguments.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='docs/how-it-works.md'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("🤖 nvidia/aws/anthropic/bedrock-claude-opus-5-5 · extensions: pit (typescript)","🤖 nvidia/aws/anthropic/bedrock-claude-opus-5-5 · tools: read, write, edit, bash, typescript · extensions: pit (typescript)")
s=s.replace("| `Setup` | | The extensions that pi-action loaded, and the variables that the tools of pi get |","| `Setup` | | The extensions and prompt templates that pi-action loaded, and the variables that the tools of pi get |")
s=s.replace("| `🤖` | The model, and the pi-durable extensions with their tools | |","| `🤖` | The model, the tools that it gets (see [Tools the model sees](extensions.md#tools-the-model-sees)), and the pi-durable extensions with their tools | |")
s=s.replace("| `▶` | A request that pi gets: who asked, where, and its first line | |","| `▶` | A request that pi gets: who asked, where, and its first line. For a [prompt template](prompts.md#prompt-templates), the line as typed and where the template comes from | |")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
npx oxfmt >/dev/null; npx vitest run src/docs.test.ts 2>&1 | grep Tests; git add -A; git commit -qm "docs: show the tools and prompt templates in the workflow log section" && git push -u origin feat/extension-prompts-and-tools 2>&1 | tail -3
